Place: A small civilian projection theater inside an orbital station, with a silent pale-blue river looping across a distant curved screen.
Activity: She slips into an aisle seat after playing the theater's lighthouse keeper and lets the quiet film continue over an empty auditorium.
Pose: Sitting in the front row three-quarters toward us, her left hand lays a small cap on the neighboring seat, her right hand rests on her right knee.
Framing: A seated three-quarter portrait at chest height with soft screen light on her face and both hands visible.
Outfit: An original adult lighthouse keeper stage costume: a structured navy halter playsuit with ivory wave piping and separate marigold shoulder panels. Settling against the chair folds the back of one panel outward like a hinge, revealing her upper shoulder while the secured playsuit stays in place.
